title: 부동산등기특별조치법에따른대법원규칙 / queue:ARTICLE:1:0:00001:part:1/1

Article 1 (Certification of Contracts, etc.)
(1) Certification under Article 3 of the Act on Special Measures for Registration of Real Estate (hereinafter referred to as the "Act") may be requested by one of the parties to the contract, a person authorized by such a party, the attorney or certified judicial scrivener who prepared the contract, or a real estate broker.
(2) An applicant for certification shall submit the original of the contract or an authentic copy of a judgment or other document. <Amended on June 26, 2020>
(3) Upon receiving an application for certification, the head of a Si, Gun, or Gu (hereinafter referred to as the "head of a Si, etc.") shall check only whether the contract, judgment, or other document satisfies the prescribed formal requirements. If the head of a Si, etc. finds no defect in the entries, the head shall certify the document without delay and deliver it to the applicant.
(4) Certification of a contract, judgment, or other document shall contain a statement to the effect that it has been certified pursuant to Article 3 of the Act, a certification number, the year, month and day of certification, and an indication of the head of the Si, etc.
(5) Where a person seeks certification of a contract, judgment, or other document involving the transfer of ownership of several parcels of real estate located in two or more Sis, Guns, or Gus, that person may apply for certification to the head of a Si, etc. having jurisdiction over one of those parcels. In such cases, the head of the Si, etc. who grants certification shall send a copy of the contract, judgment, or other document to the heads of the tax offices having jurisdiction over the locations of the respective parcels.
(6) A person to whom the head of a Si, etc. may delegate certification authority under Article 3 (1) of the Act shall be the head of an Eup, Myeon, or Dong. If the head of a Si, etc. delegates such authority to the head of an Eup, Myeon, or Dong, the head of the Si, etc. shall notify the head of the competent registry office without delay.
